answer.rationale: Primary region write path is degraded 5x above target during peak settlement traffic, 2 hours post-release. Immediate regional failover mirrors memory_b2's successful pattern: fast latency recovery and clean traffic shift without write loss. Verifying b1 (rollback success path) and b2 (failover execution) to confirm approach. Failover preserves write capacity while incident is isolated to primary; can pursue root cause (release vs. capacity) during shift to secondary. Read replica routing (b5) targets reads only and won't help write path. Circuit breaker (b4) doesn't solve latency, only prevents cascades. Capacity addition (b3) is too slow for current peak. Rollback is lower-confidence without understanding if regression is in code vs. traffic pattern shift. Failover buys time and maintains SLO during highest-stakes settlement window.
